seo.title: Aikido for children in Lisbon | Dojo da Luz
seo.description: Aikido for children and teenagers aged 5 to 17 in Benfica and Encarnação.

title: Growing without competition.
lead: A practice that develops the body, attention and relationships with others.
paragraphs: Aikido supports a child's physical, mental and relational development. It does not rely on physical strength: circular movements receive and guide a partner's energy.
With no competition, each child progresses at their own pace with the teacher's support. Classes combine technique, games and exercises for concentration, imagination, flexibility and reflexes.
goals: Learn the technical repertoire of Tokyo Aikikai
Train outdoors and take part in the Aiki garden
Join seminars and exchanges with other children
